profile.update_rule: immutable after normative freeze; changed meaning requires new identity
profile.binds: future reducers and acceptance controls using qualifier-grounding-policy-v2
profile.check: Preparation checks validate syntax/custody; reducer qualification is NOT_RUN. No semantic assessor is enforced.
profile.escape: Stop with APPARATUS_INVALID or a separately identified successor; never change frozen normative bytes to fit a candidate.

scope: Pure assessment_ledger -> decision_record; all semantic assessments are declared inputs. No answer text is authorized or emitted.
authority: Only declared QUOTE witnesses for Q and declared BODY witnesses for N/P. Assessment declarations do not establish real-world semantic truth.

definitions.M: The set of all declared obligation IDs. On a COMPLETE determinate decision every obligation must have materiality MATERIAL. The interface deliberately has no nonmaterial obligation category.
definitions.Q: Selected quote aperture. Authorized witnesses have surface QUOTE and include Q in apertures.
definitions.N: Nominated citation BODY aperture. Authorized witnesses have surface BODY and include N in apertures; the same witnesses must also include P.
definitions.P: Entire authorized packet BODY aperture. Authorized witnesses have surface BODY and include P in apertures.
definitions.E_a: Union of entails IDs across authorized witnesses in aperture a.
definitions.C_a: Union of contradicts IDs across authorized witnesses in aperture a.
definitions.A_a: Union of ambiguous IDs across authorized witnesses in aperture a.
definitions.conflict_a: E_a intersect C_a. Entailment and contradiction for the same obligation in the same authorized aperture is unresolved disagreement, within or across witnesses.
definitions.S: E_P, the packet-supported obligation set, used for authorization only after all global uncertainty and packet contradictions have been excluded.
definitions.D: M minus E_P. Diagnostic missing_packet_ids includes contradictions or ambiguity lacking entailment; it is not a safe removable set until a determinate safe projection is accepted.
definitions.opaque_identifiers: Case, obligation and witness identifiers are opaque strings. Renaming by a bijection changes only echoed identifiers. Their wording, sorting position and record order have no semantic force.
definitions.absence: A witness that does not mention an obligation is silent, not a contradictory assessment. Partial witnesses may combine by union.
definitions.cross_aperture: Q may disagree with N/P without becoming BODY authority. Global uncertainty arises from ambiguity or entailment/contradiction overlap within an authorized aperture; mere missing Q/N support does not create uncertainty.

local_aperture_aggregation.condition: A_a is nonempty or conflict_a is nonempty

local_aperture_note: Local findings use the declared IDs even if materiality/coverage is unknown. They are provisional descriptive diagnostics only. Unauthorized witnesses never enter E/C/A or considered_witness_ids. M is nonempty by schema.

sources.AUTHORIZED_AMBIGUITY: A_Q, A_N or A_P is nonempty
sources.AUTHORIZED_CONFLICT: conflict_Q, conflict_N or conflict_P is nonempty
sources.DECOMPOSITION_UNKNOWN: at least one null guard in an applicable proposal

global_uncertainty.body_disagreement: A material authorized BODY witness entails an obligation and another contradicts it in a shared authorized aperture: AUTHORIZED_CONFLICT. Two partial non-conflicting witnesses do not create disagreement. Witness silence is not a negative assertion.
global_uncertainty.pure_contradiction: C_P without any uncertainty or entailment/contradiction overlap is a determinate contradiction and rejects the complete claim. A claim cannot be rescued by trimming a contradicted obligation.
global_uncertainty.propagation: Any source makes assessment_status INCONCLUSIVE, action WITHHOLD, finding INCONCLUSIVE; all three authoritative apertures, grounding and citation become INCONCLUSIVE; core_ids, gap_ids and witness_ids are empty.
global_uncertainty.diagnostic_exception: diagnostics.local_apertures may retain SUPPORTED/OVER_BROAD/UNSUPPORTED locally descriptive findings. These are never authority to keep or emit a claim. No authoritative aperture may remain SUPPORTED on an INCONCLUSIVE decision.
global_uncertainty.integrity_uncertainty: integrity UNKNOWN is apparatus uncertainty, precedes all semantic uncertainty, and requires STOP/APPARATUS_FAILURE with NOT_ASSESSED fields and cleared diagnostics except apparatus_code. It is never an ordinary WITHHOLD semantic decision.

citation.target: Coverage of the original complete claim M, never coverage of a proposed smaller core.

precedence.condition: local N is SUPPORTED and local Q is not SUPPORTED
local N and local Q are SUPPORTED

citation.SUFFICIENT: Both selected quote Q and nominated BODY N cover every obligation without ambiguity or contradiction. It says nothing independently about semantic truth.
citation.QUOTE_INSUFFICIENT: Nominated BODY N supports the complete claim, but selected quote Q does not. N implies P by schema; packet can remain FULL_BODY_SUPPORT.
citation.NOMINATION_INSUFFICIENT: Nominated BODY N does not support the complete claim. This takes precedence even if Q is full or both Q and N are incomplete. P may still fully support the claim using other BODY witnesses.
citation.INCONCLUSIVE: The decision is globally semantically unresolved. Raw Q/N states are diagnostics only.
citation.NOT_ASSESSED: Input/integrity apparatus failure prevented authoritative assessment.
citation.separation: P grounding never directly selects a citation enum. A packet defect may coexist with NOMINATION_INSUFFICIENT because N is independently deficient; citation is chosen from Q/N after the global gates, not from packet labels.

proposal.applicable: Only after valid integrity and no base uncertainty, C_P empty, and 0 < size(E_P) < size(M). At this stage a non-null proposal is applicable; null proposal is absent. Proposals on full packet support, packet contradiction or zero supported packet obligations are NOT_REQUIRED, including their guard values.
proposal.unknown_precedence: For an applicable proposal any null guard causes DECOMPOSITION_UNKNOWN before testing false guards or structural safety. Unknown does not become support merely because a different guard is false.
safe_requires: All six guards are exactly true.
core_ids equals E_P and gap_ids equals M minus E_P, both nonempty, disjoint and exhaustive. Every supported material condition is retained; no unsupported content is silently discarded.
body_witness_ids is nonempty; every listed ID is an authorized P BODY witness and entails at least one core ID; union of their entails covers every core ID.
proposal.guards_are_declarations: No reducer establishes bindings, presuppositions, independent removal or semantic safety; it verifies declared guards and structural coverage only.
proposal.unsafe: An applicable proposal with no null guard but any false guard or failed safe requirement is UNSAFE. An absent proposal cannot authorize a projection.
proposal.schema_vs_safety: Unknown references, duplicate identifiers, malformed enums/fields or illegal witness aperture assignments are input apparatus errors. Validly encoded but non-exhaustive, overlapping, empty, unsupported or unsuitable proposal partitions/witness sets are unsafe decomposition, not apparatus errors.

decision_precedence.condition: input violates interface, integrity is UNKNOWN or integrity is other than VALID
any base uncertainty (coverage/materiality/authorized ambiguity/authorized conflict), or DECOMPOSITION_UNKNOWN in applicable proposal
E_P equals M and citation is SUFFICIENT
E_P equals M and citation is deficient
partial packet support and applicable SAFE proposal
partial packet support and UNSAFE or absent proposal

retained_fields.core_ids: All material obligation IDs retained in the authorized content. KEEP_FULL/HOLD_FOR_CITATION retain all M; PROPOSE_CORE_WITH_GAP retains exactly S. This field is not reserved for decomposed projections.
retained_fields.gap_ids: Only PROPOSE_CORE_WITH_GAP records the explicit missing-content companion D attached to an accepted safe projection. Gap IDs are visible omissions, not assertions of their truth and not safe omissions on other actions.
retained_fields.witness_ids: Only BODY P witnesses used as support for retained core_ids. For KEEP_FULL/HOLD_FOR_CITATION include every authorized P BODY witness whose entails intersects M. For PROPOSE_CORE_WITH_GAP include exactly the accepted proposal body_witness_ids. No QUOTE/QUERY/HEADING/METADATA ID appears here.
retained_fields.order: All output identifier arrays are unique and sorted in lexicographic Unicode code-point order; input arrays are unordered. No minimal witness set is selected.

KEEP_FULL.witness_ids: all contributing authorized P BODY witnesses
KEEP_FULL.output_authority: complete content retained; selected citation sufficient

HOLD_FOR_CITATION.witness_ids: all contributing authorized P BODY witnesses
HOLD_FOR_CITATION.output_authority: complete BODY-supported content retained; publication/emission remains held for citation repair; no content trimmed

PROPOSE_CORE_WITH_GAP.output_authority: safe smaller proposal with mandatory explicit gap, original complete claim remains non-supported; no prose emitted

REJECT_COMPLETE.output_authority: no complete claim or smaller projection authorized

WITHHOLD.output_authority: no content authorized under global uncertainty

STOP.output_authority: no semantic output assessed or authorized

diagnostics.authority: Every diagnostics field is descriptive and has zero retained-content authority. Diagnostics never override the action or authoritative aperture fields.
diagnostics.local_apertures: Q/N/P local aggregation using M on valid-integrity ledgers, even when global uncertainty collapses authoritative fields.
diagnostics.missing_packet_ids: sorted D (M minus E_P), on valid-integrity ledgers; missing entailment only, not a judgment of safe removability.
diagnostics.ambiguous_ids: sorted union of A_Q, A_N, A_P
diagnostics.conflicting_ids: sorted union of conflict_Q, conflict_N, conflict_P
diagnostics.considered_witness_ids: all authorized Q/N/P witnesses with at least one entails/contradicts/ambiguous assessment; unauthorized-surface and empty-assessment witnesses excluded
diagnostics.uncertainty_sources: sorted names of all base sources plus DECOMPOSITION_UNKNOWN if applicable; empty on determinate decisions
diagnostics.proposal_status: NOT_ASSESSED if apparatus failure or base uncertainty; NOT_REQUIRED if full support/packet contradiction/no supported core; ABSENT if applicable stage and proposal null; UNKNOWN if applicable and any null guard; SAFE or UNSAFE otherwise
diagnostics.apparatus_code: NONE on valid-integrity schema-valid ledgers; INVALID_INPUT takes precedence over INTEGRITY_UNKNOWN, which takes precedence over INTEGRITY_NOT_VALID.
diagnostics.reject: Preserve local findings, citation status, missing/contradicted/considered IDs and proposal status in diagnostics. Authoritative core/gap/witness lists remain empty.
diagnostics.withhold: Preserve diagnostic local findings and all computable diagnostic IDs; authoritative aperture/grounding/citation fields are INCONCLUSIVE, retained lists empty.
diagnostics.stop: Every diagnostic ID/source list empty, local_apertures all NOT_ASSESSED, proposal_status NOT_ASSESSED; apparatus_code records the failure. Do not turn untrusted ledger content into semantic diagnostics.

non_claims: No semantic assessor implementation or qualification; natural-language materiality, support, contradiction, bindings and decomposition safety remain unestablished.
No arbitrary-prose grounding, production grounding or maintained generation behavior promoted.
No new answer text, project model/provider calls, generation or gate replay, protected payload access, CAL integration, ADR-018 change, merge or release.
Finite future controls can qualify only this frozen tested ledger contract; correctness on all possible ledgers is not proven.
